The HTTP Basic Authentication modules in ((OTRS)) Community Edition 6 and prior accept the authenticated username from either the REMOTE_USER or HTTP_REMOTE_USER environment variable. In CGI and mod_perl based deployments, HTTP request headers may be mapped to corresponding HTTP_* environment variables. As a result, an unauthenticated remote attacker can supply a crafted Remote-User request header which is exposed to the application as HTTP_REMOTE_USER. When HTTP Basic Authentication is configured as the authentication backend, OTRS trusts this value as an already authenticated username and does not perform an additional password verification. An attacker may therefore authenticate through the Generic Interface as an existing agent or customer user without knowing the corresponding credentials.

The resulting privileges depend on the account being impersonated. Successful exploitation may allow access to confidential information and modification of data or configuration with the permissions of the affected user. Exploitation requires HTTP Basic Authentication to be configured as an authentication backend and a web server environment in which attacker-controlled HTTP headers are exposed through the corresponding HTTP_* environment variables.

OTRS 7 and later are not affected by this attack vector due to the use of Mojolicious/Hypnotoad and does not expose arbitrary request headers through %ENV in the manner required for exploitation. The supported REMOTE_USER mechanism additionally requires validation through the configured SSO shared secret. The unused HTTP_REMOTE_USER fallback has nevertheless been removed as a security-hardening measure.

Please note that ((OTRS)) Community Edition 6.x and before are vulnerable. Products based on the ((OTRS)) Community Edition also very likely to be affected

User-controlled values are not sufficiently neutralized when included in CSV exports. Values originating from user input, including data submitted by authenticated users or received through external communication channels such as email, may be stored in fields that are later included in CSV exports. An attacker can therefore inject values beginning with spreadsheet formula characters such as =, +, -, or @. An attacker does not necessarily require an authenticated account if the affected field can be populated through an external input channel such as incoming email.

When an affected CSV file is opened in spreadsheet software, the application may interpret these values as formulas instead of plain text. Depending on the spreadsheet application and its security configuration, a malicious formula may cause unintended actions, disclose information, or invoke external functionality. Exploitation may require the user opening the exported CSV file to confirm one or more security warning dialogs. The vulnerability does not execute code on the OTRS server; any additional impact occurs in the spreadsheet application used to process the exported file.

OTRS does not sufficiently enforce the uniqueness of customer user identities across multiple configured CustomerUser backends. When multiple backends, such as a database and LDAP, are configured, the uniqueness check for customer user email addresses is performed only within the selected backend. As a result, an authenticated user with permission to create or modify customer users may create a customer user whose email address is already assigned to a customer user in another backend.

This can result in multiple customer user records representing the same communication identity. Depending on the affected workflow and backend resolution, customer-related information or email communication may subsequently be associated with or exposed to the wrong customer user.

The vulnerability does not allow unauthenticated users to create customer accounts. Exploitation requires permissions to create or modify customer users.

Several administrative actions do not sufficiently validate whether a request was intentionally initiated by the authenticated user. In particular, the DBUpdateLogCleanUp action can be triggered through a GET request without validating a ChallengeToken. An unauthenticated remote attacker can therefore cause the browser of an authenticated administrator to execute the cleanup action by embedding a crafted request in a malicious web page. Successful exploitation can delete existing DBUpdate log entries. This may reduce the availability of diagnostic and historical information used for troubleshooting and auditing. The impact is limited to DBUpdate log entries that exist at the time the forged request is processed.

Additional administrative endpoints were identified that do not validate a ChallengeToken. Some of these endpoints can trigger administrative actions such as deploying or synchronizing already existing configuration. They do not allow an attacker to introduce arbitrary new configuration through the CSRF request itself. 

Export and read-only endpoints were also identified without ChallengeToken validation. While these endpoints may be triggered through a forged cross-site request, the response content remains subject to the browser's same-origin restrictions and is not automatically exposed to the attacker. Therefore, no direct confidentiality impact has been demonstrated for these endpoints.

Previously issued authentication tokens are not immediately invalidated when an OTRS agent or customer user account is deactivated or its password is changed. As a result, an existing JWT may remain valid until its regular expiration time, which can be approximately 16 hours.

An attacker who has previously obtained a valid authentication token can therefore continue to access OTRS with the privileges of the affected agent or customer user even after the corresponding account has been deactivated or the user's password has been changed.

The vulnerability does not allow an attacker to obtain authentication tokens by itself. Exploitation requires possession of a previously issued and still valid token. The actual impact depends on the privileges associated with the compromised token. Customer user tokens are limited to the permissions of the affected customer account, while agent tokens may provide access to broader ticket, customer, or administrative functionality depending on the assigned permissions.

A path traversal vulnerability in the OTRS SendSupportBundle functionality allows an authenticated administrator to reference file paths outside the intended directory.

This may allow files accessible to the OTRS application process to be deleted. The vulnerability does not bypass operating system file permissions. On OTRS versions prior to OTRS 7, the effective permissions of the web server process are relevant. Starting with OTRS 7, access is limited by the permissions of the dedicated OTRS user. Files with overly permissive ownership or file system permissions may therefore also be affected.

The affected functionality may additionally attempt to include controlled files in a support bundle. However, support bundles are sent to a predefined OTRS support address, and direct disclosure of arbitrary files to the attacker has not been demonstrated.

An attacker therefore requires valid administrative access to exploit the vulnerable functionality. The primary demonstrated impact is the deletion of files outside the intended directory within the effective permissions of the OTRS application process.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

sched/cache: Decouple sched_cache_group from mm to fix UAF

Currently the sched cache grouping is by mm and the scheduling statistics
sched_cache_stat lives in the mm structure.  This ties the life cycle
of scheduling stats with mm.

In account_mm_sched(), the scheduling stats are accessed by
task->mm->sc_stat.  However, a task may be switching mm on one CPU when
another CPU is running account_mm_sched(), and possibly accessing the
old mm that was freed.  This problem was found when running tests with
KASAN by Hyunwoo:

  https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/apPb-Dr4nPYuHQOK@v4bel/

Instead of serializing the mm access by introducing extra acquisition of
rq lock in the mm free path, extract sched_cache_stat from mm_struct,
rename it as sched_cache_group and manage its life cycle apart from
mm_struct with its own ref counting.  This allows us in the next patch
access sched_cache_group directly from task, and add a refcount
on sched_cache_group when a task links to it. This prevents the use
after free issue when accessing stale and released old mm and its
sched cache stat a task switches to a new mm while account_mm_sched()
is done elsewhere.

The other benefit of this restructure is in the future, the grouping of
tasks to a LLC would have the flexibility to be associated with a user
defined grouping, or cgroup, cookie group, numa_group or others instead
of just with a single mm address space.

Rename sched_cache_stat to sched_cache_group and turn it into a refcounted
object allocated from mm_struct.  The mm_struct now holds a pointer
(sched_cache_grp) to this object instead of embedding it.

An **incorrect authorization** flaw has been found in **network interface handling** in the **Foreman** package. The domain and subnet interface API checks only that the caller holds a host permission. It does not apply the search limit on that permission, so the request is answered from every interface on the domain or subnet. A low-privileged network attacker or user must already be allowed to view some hosts and to view a domain or subnet shared with other hosts. They can request that domain or subnet's interfaces. The response includes interface records of hosts they are not allowed to view. If the attacker or user is also allowed to edit some hosts, they can submit a change to one of those interfaces. The interface is then saved with that change.

A flaw has been found in **permission filters** in the **foreman** package. The API loads a filter by its identifier and does not apply the search limit on the caller's permission. A low-privileged network attacker or user must already be allowed to delete filters for one role only. They can delete filters that belong to other unlocked roles. Those other roles then lose the access the deleted filters had granted.

The Metasploit Framework post module post/apple_ios/gather/ios_image_gather is affected by a relative path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22). The module interpolates file names taken from a Meterpreter directory listing — data fully controlled by a hostile or tampered iOS device — directly into the local destination path passed to client.fs.file.download_file(), with no sanitization. The underlying stdapi sink (lib/rex/post/meterpreter/extensions/stdapi/fs/file.rb) writes to whatever path is supplied, so a listing entry such as ../../msfconsole.rc escapes the intended ~/.msf4/loot/<random> directory and overwrites ~/.msf4/msfconsole.rc, a resource file that every msfconsole invocation automatically executes at startup (lib/msf/ui/console/driver.rb:196). An attacker-controlled device that lures an operator into running this gather module achieves an arbitrary file write as the operator; because the written msfconsole.rc can load a second written file (a Ruby plugin whose top-level code runs on require), this converts into persistent code execution and an interactive shell as the operator (frequently root) on the pentester's workstation at the next console launch. The same traversal was previously fixed upstream in the recursive downloader (stdapi/fs/dir.rb scrubs separators); this module omitted the equivalent scrub. The fix applies the same separator scrub (or File.basename) to listing entries before building the local path.

VeraCrypt 1.26.29 (FUSE-T build) on macOS sometimes allows unintended access to decrypted data. It does not terminate the FUSE-T auxiliary service (go-nfsv4) and its associated VeraCrypt core-service helper processes when a volume is dismounted. After VeraCrypt reports the volume as dismounted, the auxiliary mount continues to serve the decrypted volume image (volume.dmg) over a loopback SMB session, and the leaked processes retain an open handle to the underlying raw device. A local user or process can therefore remount and access the decrypted volume without the passphrase, e.g., by reopening a previously accessed path (such as through a macOS Open Recent menu) or by attaching volume.dmg from the stale auxiliary mount. (The macFUSE build of VeraCrypt is not affected.)

ngx_cache_purge before 3.0.4 can allow file deletion via a symlink attack in certain situations where nginx and a served application (e.g., WordPress) run under the same user account. The attacker must be able to create a symlink inside the cache path. Version 3.0.4 fixes this for the case of a symlink created at an arbitrary earlier time, but does not resolve an applicable TOCTOU race condition. (The ngx_cache_purge module follows symlinks while walking the cache directory tree during purge operations. The module relies on nginx's ngx_walk_tree(), which relies on stat() and therefore follows symlinks.)

Blinko through 1.8.8 allows directory traversal, overwriting startup files as root, via installPlugin. It builds the plugin install path from an unsanitized name in server/routerTrpc/plugin.ts, and the plugin.installPlugin tRPC procedure is open to any authenticated user. Thus, a name containing ../ sequences writes the downloaded plugin files outside the plugins directory. Because the official Docker image runs as root, an authenticated attacker overwrites a root-owned startup file and achieves remote code execution as root. Self-registration for an account may be possible.

ai.summary_en: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by remote code execution, command injection, and memory corruption flaws spanning desktop operating systems, web applications, and database middleware. Critical weaknesses in platforms such as IBM Maximo, Red Hat OpenShift, KubeVirt, and numerous consumer routers expose cloud orchestration, network infrastructure, and development environments to unauthenticated compromise. Concurrently, security gaps in AI inference tooling, mobile media decoders, and industrial control systems reveal an expanding attack surface targeting automation, edge devices, and operational technology. These findings emphasize the critical importance of strict input validation, robust container isolation, and rapid remediation of exposed credentials across enterprise and consumer deployments.
ai.summary_zh: 当前的漏洞态势主要由远程代码执行、命令注入和内存损坏漏洞主导，波及桌面操作系统、Web 应用程序和数据库中间件。IBM Maximo、Red Hat OpenShift、KubeVirt 以及众多消费级路由器等平台的关键弱点，使云编排、网络基础设施和开发环境面临未认证攻陷的风险。与此同时，AI 推理工具、移动媒体解码器和工业控制系统中的安全缺口揭示了针对自动化、边缘设备和运营技术的攻击面正在不断扩大。这些发现强调了在企业级和消费级部署中严格执行输入验证、实施强容器隔离以及快速修复泄露凭据的重要性。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Samsung's HEIF decoder allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code, directly compromising mobile device integrity and media processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 三星的 HEIF 解码器存在输入验证不当的问题，允许本地攻击者执行任意代码，直接破坏移动设备的完整性及媒体处理流水线。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in Samsung's WSM service enables local privilege escalation to system level, breaching mobile OS security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 三星的 WSM 服务中存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致本地权限提升至系统级，从而突破移动操作系统的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Unisoc modem OTA stack enables remote code execution via malicious cellular broadcast messages without authentication.
items.reason_zh: 展锐调制解调器 OTA 协议栈中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可在未认证的情况下通过恶意蜂窝广播消息实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Samsung Continuity Service permits adjacent attackers to manipulate paired mobile devices, potentially compromising user data and session continuity.
items.reason_zh: 三星 Continuity 服务存在访问控制不当的问题，允许邻近攻击者操控已配对的移动设备，可能导致用户数据泄露及会话连续性受损。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in the IBM Maximo Application Suite IoT component can trigger severe denial of service. This directly threatens the availability of industrial IoT management platforms and connected device telemetry pipelines.
items.reason_zh: IBM Maximo Application Suite 的 IoT 组件中存在不受控制的递归问题，可能触发严重的拒绝服务攻击。这将直接威胁工业物联网管理平台及连接设备遥测流水线的可用性。

items.reason_en: An infinite parsing loop in the IoT component causes resource exhaustion when processing specific inputs. Maintaining continuous data ingestion from field sensors relies on mitigating this flaw to prevent operational downtime.
items.reason_zh: 该 IoT 组件在处理特定输入时会陷入无限解析循环，导致资源耗尽。为保障从现场传感器持续采集数据并防止运营停机，必须修复此缺陷。

items.reason_en: Publicly disclosed remote command injection in the router's WLAN configuration form allows attackers to fully compromise the device and pivot to internal networks.
items.reason_zh: 路由器 WLAN 配置表单中公开披露的远程命令注入漏洞，可使攻击者完全控制设备并横向渗透至内部网络。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated Bluetooth interface on DJI drones permits attackers within range to modify Wi-Fi credentials and regulatory settings, enabling full device takeover.
items.reason_zh: 大疆无人机的未认证蓝牙接口允许范围内的攻击者修改 Wi-Fi 凭据和监管设置，从而实现完全接管设备。

items.reason_en: Denver SHO-110 IP cameras expose an unauthenticated HTTP snapshot endpoint, allowing remote adversaries to stream live video feeds without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Denver SHO-110 IP 摄像头暴露了未认证的 HTTP 快照端点，使远程攻击者无需凭据即可获取实时视频流。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the Pi Agent Dashboard terminal handler allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on embedded monitoring devices.
items.reason_zh: Pi Agent Dashboard 的终端处理器中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者在嵌入式监控设备上执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Improper control of code generation in IBM Maximo AI Service allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. This critical flaw undermines cloud AI workloads and could lead to complete tenant isolation breaches.
items.reason_zh: IBM Maximo AI 服务中代码生成控制不当，允许远程攻击者执行任意代码。此关键缺陷破坏了云 AI 工作负载的安全性，并可能导致租户隔离彻底失效。

items.reason_en: The Windows Machine Config Operator's CSR auto-approver fails to reject Certificate Signing Requests containing additional organization values like system:masters. Compromised nodes can leverage this to escalate privileges across Red Hat OpenShift clusters.
items.reason_zh: Windows Machine Config Operator 的 CSR 自动审批器未能拒绝包含 system:masters 等额外组织值的证书签名请求。被攻陷的节点可利用此漏洞在 Red Hat OpenShift 集群中提权。

items.reason_en: Container escape in sandboxed.sh allows workspace code to access the host filesystem via nsenter without root namespace restriction. This breaks fundamental cloud development isolation guarantees and exposes host data to rogue containers.
items.reason_zh: sandboxed.sh 中存在容器逃逸漏洞，允许工作区代码通过 nsenter 在无根命名空间限制的情况下访问宿主机文件系统。这破坏了云开发的基础隔离保障，使宿主数据面临失控容器的威胁。

items.reason_en: KubeVirt's safepath package resolves symlinks via /proc/self/fd/N despite using O_NOFOLLOW, enabling path traversal attacks. This flaw compromises virtual machine security boundaries in Kubernetes environments.
items.reason_zh: 尽管使用了 O_NOFOLLOW 标志，KubeVirt 的 safepath 包仍会通过 /proc/self/fd/N 解析符号链接，从而导致路径遍历攻击。此缺陷破坏了 Kubernetes 环境中虚拟机的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Compromised spoke clusters can inject unauthorized endpoints into broker namespaces by exploiting label-driven resource injection, disrupting multi-cluster Kubernetes deployments.
items.reason_zh: 被攻陷的 spoke 集群可利用标签驱动的資源注入漏洞，向 broker 命名空间注入未授权的端点，从而破坏多集群 Kubernetes 部署。

items.reason_en: Malicious Flatpak repositories can write to arbitrary host locations via extra data extraction, executing as root on system installs and compromising build pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 恶意 Flatpak 仓库可通过额外数据提取功能向任意宿主机位置写入文件，在系统安装模式下以 root 权限运行，从而破坏构建流水线。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated path traversal in gvproxy allows attackers to delete arbitrary files on the host system, representing a critical container-to-host escape vector.
items.reason_zh: gvproxy 中的未认证路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者删除宿主机上的任意文件，构成关键的容器到主机逃逸途径。

items.reason_en: TrustyAI Service lacks proper network segmentation, allowing any cluster pod to bypass authentication and tamper with monitoring APIs and configurations.
items.reason_zh: TrustyAI Service 缺乏适当的网络隔离，导致任何集群 Pod 均可绕过身份验证并篡改监控 API 与配置。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Ollama's Pull API enables remote attackers to force the server to fetch malicious resources, compromising AI inference environments.
items.reason_zh: Ollama 的 Pull API 存在 SSRF 漏洞，使远程攻击者能够强制服务器获取恶意资源，从而破坏 AI 推理环境。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication logic in the Data Plane API drops security controls across multiple transports, enabling unauthorized remote management of HAProxy instances.
items.reason_zh: Data Plane API 的身份验证逻辑缺陷导致多种传输协议下的安全控制失效，使攻击者能够未经授权远程管理 HAProxy 实例。

items.reason_en: Remote argument injection in the DDNS CGI function allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on network routers without authentication.
items.reason_zh: DDNS CGI 函数中的远程参数注入漏洞允许攻击者在无需认证的情况下于网络路由器上执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Multiple remote OS command injections and stack-based buffer overflows in Linksys E1700 router firmware allow unauthenticated attackers to fully compromise home networks.
items.reason_zh: Linksys E1700 路由器固件中存在多项远程 OS 命令注入及基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者完全接管家庭网络。

items.reason_en: Flaws in MikroTik RouterOS WinBox authentication enable low-privilege users to extract authorization policies for other accounts, facilitating lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: MikroTik RouterOS WinBox 的身份验证缺陷使低权限用户能够提取其他账户的授权策略，从而促进横向移动。

items.reason_en: Insufficient input validation in Netlink ICT router diagnostics allows authenticated attackers to upload and execute arbitrary scripts, leading to complete device control.
items.reason_zh: Netlink ICT 路由器诊断功能中的输入验证不足，允许已认证的攻击者上传并执行任意脚本，从而导致设备被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Critical OS command injection in TRENDnet router firmware allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain full device control and pivot to internal networks.
items.reason_zh: TRENDnet 路由器固件中存在严重的 OS 命令注入漏洞，允许未认证的远程攻击者获取设备完全控制权并向内网渗透。

items.reason_en: Persistent default factory credentials with administrative access remain active even after custom accounts are configured. This severely weakens Red Lion Controls PLC/SCADA devices, enabling immediate unauthorized network access.
items.reason_zh: 即使配置了自定义账户，具有管理员权限的出厂默认凭据仍会持续生效。这严重削弱了 Red Lion Controls PLC/SCADA 设备的安全性，使攻击者能够立即进行未授权的网络访问。

items.reason_en: Plaintext storage of usernames and passwords in configuration files accessible via TFTP or CLI allows credential theft. Attackers can extract these credentials to pivot laterally across unprotected OT networks.
items.reason_zh: 配置文件中的用户名和密码通过 TFTP 或 CLI 可访问且以明文形式存储，易遭凭据窃取。攻击者可利用这些凭据在未受保护的 OT 网络中进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use of a hard-coded cryptographic key in ZKTeco BioTime undermines encryption guarantees for physical access control logs, facilitating unauthorized system tampering.
items.reason_zh: ZKTeco BioTime 使用硬编码加密密钥，破坏了物理访问控制日志的加密保障，便于攻击者进行未授权的系统篡改。

items.reason_en: Improper data sanitization in IBM i's HTTP Server Administration web application enables remote authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code or exfiltrate sensitive information. The web-facing nature of this admin interface makes it a prime target for exploitation.
items.reason_zh: IBM i 的 HTTP Server Administration Web 应用程序存在数据清理不当问题，使远程已认证攻击者能够执行任意代码或窃取敏感信息。该管理界面面向 Web 暴露的特性使其成为优先攻击目标。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature spoofing in the OpenCart Virtual POS Module allows attackers to forge transaction signatures by bypassing validation checks. This creates direct financial fraud risks for e-commerce platforms processing electronic money.
items.reason_zh: OpenCart Virtual POS Module 存在加密签名伪造漏洞，攻击者可通过绕过验证检查来伪造交易签名。这为处理电子货币的电商平台带来直接的金融欺诈风险。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in Frappe ERPNext allows any authenticated user to create records with disabled permission checks. This undermines multi-tenant data segregation and can grant unauthorized users administrative capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Frappe ERPNext 存在权限提升漏洞，允许任何已认证用户在禁用权限检查的情况下创建记录。这破坏了多租户数据隔离机制，可能导致未授权用户获得管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded super-admin credentials in Rapyd Admin allow unauthenticated attackers to gain full system control via a seeded installer account. This trivially bypasses authentication mechanisms and requires immediate patching.
items.reason_zh: Rapyd Admin 中存在硬编码的超级管理员凭据，未认证攻击者可通过预置的安装程序账户获取系统完全控制权。该漏洞轻易绕过了身份验证机制，需立即修补。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated bypass of security controls on generated Quarkus endpoints occurs when developers customize operations without explicitly re-declaring required security roles.
items.reason_zh: 当开发人员自定义操作但未显式重新声明所需的安全角色时，生成的 Quarkus 端点会出现安全控制的未认证绕过问题。

items.reason_en: Deterministic unsalted MD5 hashing for OAuth-provisioned accounts enables offline credential cracking and widespread account takeover by remote attackers.
items.reason_zh: 针对 OAuth 配置账户采用确定性的无盐值 MD5 哈希算法，使得远程攻击者能够进行离线凭据破解并大规模接管账户。

items.reason_en: A Twig sandbox bypass allows non-admin users to invoke arbitrary PHP callables like passthru through templated views, leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Twig 沙箱绕过漏洞允许非管理员用户通过模板视图调用如 passthru 等任意 PHP 函数，从而导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted upload of dangerous file types in PX-lab Zombify allows direct web shell deployment, granting immediate remote code execution on targeted servers.
items.reason_zh: PX-lab Zombify 中危险文件类型的上传限制缺失，允许直接部署 Webshell，从而在目标服务器上实现即时远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Dassault Systèmes Tuleap suffers from multiple critical flaws including OS command injection, stored XSS, and SQLi, severely impacting enterprise collaboration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Dassault Systèmes Tuleap 存在多项严重漏洞，包括 OS 命令注入、存储型 XSS 和 SQL 注入，严重影响企业协作工作流。

items.reason_en: Mass assignment vulnerability in jshERP enables authenticated users to overwrite protected fields like tenant_id and passwords, breaking multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: jshERP 存在批量赋值漏洞，允许已认证用户覆盖 tenant_id 和密码等受保护字段，破坏多租户隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Remote blind SQL injection in Exponent CMS XML-RPC login functionality allows unauthenticated attackers to extract database contents or escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: Exponent CMS 的 XML-RPC 登录功能存在远程盲注 SQL 注入漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者提取数据库内容或提升权限。

items.reason_en: Directory traversal flaw in Blinko's plugin installation mechanism allows authenticated users to overwrite root-owned startup files, leading to privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Blinko 的插件安装机制存在目录遍历漏洞，允许已认证用户覆盖属主为 root 的启动文件，从而导致权限提升。

items.reason_en: Manipulation of the email argument in jackq XCMS password recovery endpoint enables account takeover attempts and information disclosure.
items.reason_zh: 对 jackq XCMS 密码找回接口的 email 参数进行操纵，可导致账户接管尝试和信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Presence of default credentials in PRVTPRO Amnezia-Web-Panel exposes backup download functionality to immediate unauthorized access and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: PRVTPRO Amnezia-Web-Panel 中存在默认凭据，导致备份下载功能面临即时的未授权访问和数据外泄风险。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in IBM Guardium Data Protection's edge-controller allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate backend database contents. This compromises data integrity and bypasses core database monitoring and protection features.
items.reason_zh: IBM Guardium Data Protection 的 edge-controller 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者操纵后端数据库内容。这会破坏数据完整性并绕过核心数据库监控与防护功能。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in JetBrains Exposed via unescaped string arguments affects a widely adopted Kotlin database framework. Developers relying on this middleware face widespread exploitation risks if input validation is not enforced.
items.reason_zh: JetBrains Exposed 因未转义的字符串参数存在 SQL 注入漏洞，影响了一款广泛使用的 Kotlin 数据库框架。若未实施输入验证，依赖此中间件的开发者将面临广泛的利用风险。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in IBM Db2's CREATE WRAPPER command allows authenticated users to expose sensitive database information. This metadata leakage can aid attackers in mapping internal database architectures for further exploitation.
items.reason_zh: IBM Db2 的 CREATE WRAPPER 命令存在授权不当问题，允许已认证用户暴露敏感数据库信息。此类元数据泄露可协助攻击者绘制内部数据库架构图以进行进一步利用。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in IBM Planning Analytics enables remote authenticated code execution. Exploiting this vulnerability compromises backend analytical workloads and grants full control over the middleware environment.
items.reason_zh: IBM Planning Analytics 存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可实现远程已认证代码执行。利用此漏洞将破坏后端分析负载，并使攻击者完全控制中间件环境。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in IBM Db2 Mirror allows authenticated attackers to bypass authorization checks and execute malicious code with elevated database privileges.
items.reason_zh: IBM Db2 Mirror 中的权限提升漏洞允许已认证的攻击者绕过授权检查，并以更高的数据库权限执行恶意代码。

items.reason_en: Memory-safety defects in the JavaScript engine integration can result in controlled process failures or memory corruption when processing complex queries.
items.reason_zh: JavaScript 引擎集成中的内存安全缺陷在处理复杂查询时可能导致可控的进程崩溃或内存损坏。

items.reason_en: The SurrealQL USE statement lacks proper authorization checks, allowing authenticated users to switch tenants and access restricted cross-tenant data.
items.reason_zh: SurrealQL 的 USE 语句缺乏适当的授权检查，允许已认证用户切换租户并访问受限的跨租户数据。

items.reason_en: Progress MarkLogic Server XQuery evaluation bypass allows remote attackers to execute server-side code with elevated privileges, risking full database compromise.
items.reason_zh: Progress MarkLogic Server 的 XQuery 评估绕过漏洞允许远程攻击者以高权限执行服务器端代码，存在导致整个数据库被完全攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Neo4j GraphQL silently ignores schema-level authentication directives for @cypher fields, effectively disabling security controls for graph database queries.
items.reason_zh: Neo4j GraphQL 会静默忽略 @cypher 字段的模式级身份验证指令，实质上禁用了图数据库查询的安全控制。

items.reason_en: Handlebars prototype pollution via constructor bypass enables arbitrary code execution during template rendering, affecting widespread JavaScript middleware stacks.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造函数绕过导致的 Handlebars 原型污染可在模板渲染期间实现任意代码执行，影响广泛的 JavaScript 中间件栈。

items.reason_en: Quarkus Qute template engine fails to restrict reflection access to sensitive Java internals, allowing template-based remote code execution in Java applications.
items.reason_zh: Quarkus Qute 模板引擎未能限制对敏感 Java 内部组件的反射访问，允许在 Java 应用程序中通过模板实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Component integrity bypass in Code for IBMi allows installation of unverified ILE components after superficial procedure checks. This introduces supply chain risks into midrange development environments and compiler toolchains.
items.reason_zh: Code for IBMi 中的组件完整性绕过漏洞允许在浅层流程检查后安装未经验证的 ILE 组件。这会将供应链风险引入中型开发环境和编译器工具链。

items.reason_en: Permission bypass in Continue CLI allows chaining unapproved commands after allowed Bash prefixes. AI-assisted coding agents can be manipulated to execute arbitrary shell operations, posing significant developer environment risks.
items.reason_zh: Continue CLI 中的权限绕过漏洞允许在允许的 Bash 前缀后串联未经批准的命令。AI 辅助编码代理可能被操纵以执行任意 Shell 操作，对开发者环境构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Quadratic backtracking in N3.js's N3Lexer triggers regular expression denial of service on long digit runs. Processing untrusted RDF or Turtle data can freeze Node.js event loops and degrade application responsiveness.
items.reason_zh: N3.js 的 N3Lexer 中的二次回溯会在长数字序列上触发正则表达式拒绝服务（ReDoS）。处理不受信任的 RDF 或 Turtle 数据可能冻结 Node.js 事件循环并降低应用响应能力。

items.reason_en: Authenticated service processor mailbox messages can overflow host firmware attribute storage to read or modify Hostboot memory regions. This undermines hardware-level security boundaries and firmware trust chains on IBM Power Systems.
items.reason_zh: 已认证的服务处理器邮箱消息可能溢出主机固件属性存储，从而读取或修改 Hostboot 内存区域。这会破坏 IBM Power Systems 上的硬件级安全边界和固件信任链。

items.reason_en: Plaintext HTTP download of pretrained model weights enables on-path attackers to substitute crafted files for remote code execution within AI inference pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 预训练模型权重的明文 HTTP 下载使路径中间人攻击者能够替换伪造文件，从而在 AI 推理流水线中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper manifest verification in secure enclave coordination allows replay attacks where withdrawn workloads regain trust and access to protected resources.
items.reason_zh: 安全飞地协调过程中的清单验证不当允许重放攻击，使已撤销的工作负载重新获得对受保护资源的信任与访问权限。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Erlang rebar3 package manager allows malicious publishers to overwrite project directories during dependency resolution, introducing supply chain risks.
items.reason_zh: Erlang rebar3 包管理器中的路径遍历漏洞允许恶意发布者在依赖解析期间覆盖项目目录，引入供应链风险。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in Square Squash allows unauthenticated attackers to store crafted YAML payloads, triggering remote code execution during symbolication processes.
items.reason_zh: Square Squash 中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许未认证的攻击者存储构造的 YAML 载荷，并在符号化过程中触发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Ansible's authorized_key module uses insecure file handling that enables local privilege escalation via symlink pre-staging, compromising automation pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Ansible 的 authorized_key 模块使用了不安全的文件处理方式，可通过预先创建符号链接实现本地权限提升，从而危及自动化流水线。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in Metasploit's iOS gather module exploits controlled file names from compromised devices, exposing sensitive host system paths.
items.reason_zh: Metasploit 的 iOS gather 模块中的相对路径遍历漏洞利用已被攻陷设备上的受控文件名，暴露敏感的主机系统路径。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in libnfs ZDR decoding occurs when caller-supplied size limits are ignored, risking memory corruption in NFS client applications.
items.reason_zh: 当忽略调用方提供的大小限制时，libnfs 的 ZDR 解码会发生越界写入，导致 NFS 客户端应用程序面临内存损坏风险。
